implementation_rule: implementation_required must be boolean. When false, implementation_proposal_id must be null. When true, implementation_proposal_id must identify one exact IMPLEMENTATION_PROPOSED package whose protected authorization permits automatic materialization only into a separate implementation PR built from protected main.
rule: After governed review establishes that a living-research result requires a Project FAR correction, the review must bind one exact nonempty scientific correction proposal plus the protected snapshot and promotion authorizations. If the correction also requires executable or control-plane changes, the same review must declare implementation_required and bind one exact separately authorized implementation proposal. The automation opens the scientific correction PR and, when required, a separate protected implementation PR. Neither path may write directly to main; merge remains governed by protected validation.
